# Gateway decomposition of degraded ancestors

**POST-HOC DESCRIPTIVE -- not preregistered, no hypothesis test.** Generated by `analysis/final/gateway_decomposition.py` from `data/campaign/runs/` and `data/graphs/`. It informs the near-tautology caveat in the Limitations (section 5.4).

Each architecture's gateway is its single in-degree-zero node. It is excluded from the analysis set as a faulted service but can be counted among the degraded ancestors of the services that are faulted.

## Per architecture and fault type

| architecture | fault | runs | runs with the gateway among degraded ancestors | fraction | services with the gateway as an ancestor |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| socialnetwork | kill | 55 | 55 | 1.000 | 11 of 11 |
| socialnetwork | latency | 55 | 55 | 1.000 | 11 of 11 |
| hotelreservation | kill | 35 | 35 | 1.000 | 7 of 7 |
| hotelreservation | latency | 35 | 35 | 1.000 | 7 of 7 |
